description: A component that builds its own model client cannot send a request past the guard.

input.scenario: The run's outbound traffic is denied by default and the guard is the only allowed destination; a recording endpoint stands in for the provider's public address outside the guard. An extension inside the run creates its own model client for that address and sends a request containing CANARY-7f3a-SECRET.

expect.behaviour: The request never leaves the run: the recording endpoint receives nothing, and nothing unmasked reaches any provider.
